prompt: Which statements about Redis structures are correct?
explanation: Sets hold unique, unordered members; sorted sets order members by an associated score; and every stream entry carries an ID of the form milliseconds-sequence. Lists preserve insertion order only — they never sort members by value.

options.text: Set members are unique and unordered
Sorted sets order members by an associated numeric score
Lists keep members sorted by value automatically
Every stream entry carries an ID of the form milliseconds-sequence
